messages.subject: progress bar: shinyIncubator vs builtin
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to migrate over to the new progress bar that comes built in with the latest shiny package. But I liked the style of a more obvious popup from shinyIncubator better. I've also used CSS code to move it to the middle of the window and make it larger.

Is there a simple way (including CSS) to make the new slider appear more like the old style? If not, could some simple options on the progress bar creation be added? 

A huge ongoing issue with our apps is that when it takes a while to do calcs users get impatient and try moving sliders. Which then queues up more changes, and it becomes a very frustrating experience for them. The very subtle status bar along the top does very little to help. Making it big and in the middle of the page, even overlapping with some of the inputs is very helpful.

Jonathan
